mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to a statistically significant negative 20-day forward return (t-test p > 0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month does not lead to a statistically significant negative 5-day forward return (t-test p > 0.05) over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ < 0% does not lead to a statistically significant negative 60-day forward return (t-test p > 0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM > 1% does not lead to a statistically significant positive 20-day forward return (t-test p > 0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5%, and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL MoM > 0% does not lead to a statistically significant negative 20-day forward return (t-test p > 0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000, the combination signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 does not lead to a statistically significant positive 5-day forward return (t-test p > 0.05) over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased demand for housing and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not lead to a statistically significant positive 60-day forward return (t-test p > 0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, when industrial production (INDPRO) is growing but the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is also rising, the combination signals a potential overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM > 0% and FEDFUNDS MoM > 0% during a late-cycle expansion does not lead to a statistically significant negative 20-day forward return (t-test p > 0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.
